summary: Nouvelle Noire's Readymag promosite for NN Swinton, a variable grotesque (wght 1–999, slnt), told through a tongue-in-cheek AI-generated history of an invented Swiss designer 'Cram Zord', with mint-green duotone in-use photos. Hover makes the type move (titles swing to heavy italic, weight rows slant), a floating 3D checkmark ticks off the facts and figures, and the page ends with a giant 'END'.

instances.look: 'Swinton' centred in black Medium on a flat mint field, with a three-line centred tagline ('Inspired by early American grotesques, crafted by a Swiss perfectionist, infused with a standardised spirit.') below, a vertical 'Introduction' label at the left edge and vertical NOUVELLE NOIRE / FREE TRIALS links at the right
instances.ux: Hovering the name swings it to heaviest italic (wght 999, slnt max) with an anticipating cubic-bezier; hovering the tagline drops it to the thinnest weight (wght 1)
instances.learn: Hide the variable range behind hover on the hero itself: the first playful gesture reveals the axes without any slider

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed 1440×900 mint; name centred at y≈160–380; tagline centred block ~1100px wide at y≈510–720; 12px vertical labels in 30px rails at both edges
reconstruction.typography: Name ~280px NN Swinton VF wght 500 slnt 0 (Readymag 200px × 1.406); tagline ~63px wght 500, leading ~1.2, centred; rail labels 12px caps rotated 90°
reconstruction.behaviour: CSS transition on font-variation-settings, 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.6,−0.28,0.74,0.05): name → 'wght' 999, 'slnt' 100 on hover; tagline → 'wght' 1
reconstruction.html: Readymag code-injection widget with [data-id] p:hover span { font-variation-settings } rules

instances.learn: Make every weight row hover to its italic: the list shows 22 styles in the space of 11

instances.feel: Expert yet fun, like an annotated proof
instances.learn: Draw the outline points on the big glyphs and mark the one detail with a coloured disc plus a tiny pictogram (scissors for ink cuts): the explanation fits in one line
